title: Aldehyd-/Keton- und Halogenidnachweise: Merkmale abrufen
titleEn: Recall features of aldehyde/ketone and halide tests
description: Die lernende Person kann die auf den Karten genannten typischen Fehling-/Tollens-Befunde bei Aldehyden und Ketonen sowie die Silberhalogenid-Befunde mithilfe der zugehörigen Lernkarten sicher abrufen.
descriptionEn: The learner can reliably recall the typical Fehling/Tollens outcomes for aldehydes and ketones and the silver-halide observations stated on the cards using the associated flashcards.

memorySupportSelection.role: Recall of previously taught compact content only. No ordinary competency, source duty, acquisition performance, or Human evidence is certified.
memorySupportSelection.selectionSemantics: Unchanged getSrsFilterTags returns the existing goal: tags because no GK/LK or new selector tag is added. The unchanged card filter uses their OR intersection; actual ordered cards are checked, not inferred from selectedCardIds.
